snapshot_label: Opportunity feed snapshot from verified bloom data sources

opportunities.title: See Iowa woodland wildflowers while they are still active
opportunities.subtitle: Fresh state DNR reports show spring woodland blooms across four Iowa regions.
opportunities.place: Northern, Central, Southern, and Western Iowa
opportunities.time_label: Go this week while reports are fresh
opportunities.location_name: Multiple Iowa woodland trails and parks
opportunities.content: Look for phlox, violets, Virginia bluebells, wild geranium, Solomon's seals, and other spring woodland flowers. This is a status-driven opportunity, not a scheduled event.
opportunities.why_interesting: The alert is timely: all four DNR regions have fresh May reports, so the user can act now instead of saving a vague seasonal idea.
opportunities.evidence_note: The report page lists May 4-5, 2026 records for Northern, Central, Southern, and Western Iowa, including trail/county references and species in bloom.
opportunities.price: Free public report; site access varies by park

opportunities.title: Follow Anza-Borrego blooms into the higher mountain routes
opportunities.subtitle: Late-season records show the desert bloom shifting upslope around Volcan Mountain and Kwaaymii Point.
opportunities.place: Anza-Borrego, Cuyamaca, Palomar, and Volcan Mountain area
opportunities.time_label: Best as a route alert, not a fixed event time
opportunities.location_name: Volcan Mountain / Kwaaymii Point West / surrounding routes
opportunities.content: The opportunity is to chase current bloom reports by route: Chinese houses, mountain bush lupine, serviceberry, larkspur, and other higher-elevation flowers appear in recent report notes.
opportunities.why_interesting: It turns a raw bloom report into a very practical weekend prompt: the desert floor is fading, but nearby higher routes still have flowers.
opportunities.evidence_note: BorregoWildflowers.org exposes a 2025-2026 bloom report with dated route records, species notes, photos, and iNaturalist links.
opportunities.organizer: Community naturalist report; official park page provides hotline/map context

opportunities.title: Use this week's Southern California wildflower hotline as a trip shortlist
opportunities.subtitle: Theodore Payne Foundation publishes weekly illustrated reports during the March-May native flower season.
opportunities.time_label: Weekly report; no single event time
opportunities.location_name: Multiple public lands and nature areas
opportunities.content: This is a curated digest opportunity: scan one report for current parks, trails, native species, and selected native plant events before choosing where to go.
opportunities.why_interesting: For users who do not know where flowers are still good, the weekly hotline acts like an editorial itinerary.
opportunities.source_name: Theodore Payne Foundation Wild Flower Hotline
opportunities.evidence_note: The latest PDF report includes region-level records, location names, species notes, bloom condition text, photos, and selected event listings.
opportunities.price: Free public report; destination fees vary

opportunities.title: Spend a July weekend touring Sequim lavender farms
opportunities.subtitle: Sequim Lavender Weekend 2026 brings farm visits and local lavender experiences during peak bloom season.
opportunities.time_label: All-day farm weekend; individual farm schedules vary
opportunities.location_name: City of Sequim and Sequim Lavender Trail farms
opportunities.content: A summer trip idea built around lavender farms, field visits, farm shops, local vendors, and bloom-season activities across the Sequim Lavender Trail.
opportunities.why_interesting: It is easy to understand and plan: one destination, one weekend, peak lavender timing, and multiple farms.
opportunities.image_credit: Sequim Lavender Trail event page image
opportunities.evidence_note: Sequim Lavender Trail events page lists Sequim Lavender Weekend 2026 and bloom-season events; visit page describes late June tint and mid-July full bloom pattern.
opportunities.price: Most farms free to visit; activities vary

opportunities.title: Follow Sequim Lavender Trail through the full July bloom season
opportunities.subtitle: A month-long bloom season gives users flexibility beyond one festival weekend.
opportunities.content: Use the month-long bloom window to visit farms, see lavender fields, shop farm products, and avoid concentrating the whole trip on one weekend.
opportunities.why_interesting: It supports reminders and flexible planning: users can choose weekdays, weekends, or the dedicated Lavender Weekend.
opportunities.image_credit: Sequim Lavender Trail events page image
opportunities.evidence_note: Events page includes Bloom Season Along the Lavender Trail, July 1-31, 2026.

opportunities.title: Start a New Hampshire foliage watchlist before peak color begins
opportunities.subtitle: The official state tracker exists, but current report rows need a fall-season refresh.
opportunities.time_label: Report cadence becomes useful in fall
opportunities.location_name: New Hampshire regions and scenic routes
opportunities.content: Invite users to follow foliage updates before the season begins, then notify them when official text reports and peak-color levels appear.
opportunities.why_interesting: This shows how the product can collect intent early, before the data source becomes live in season.
opportunities.last_updated: 2026 site verified; fall report pending season
opportunities.evidence_note: The tracker page exposes Launch Foliage Tracker, a text-only updated foliage reports link, and a peak foliage map link; current report rows were not visible during off-season validation.

opportunities.title: Join an early-morning photo walk through Holland tulips
opportunities.subtitle: Tulip Time offered guided Photo Walks at the Tulip Immersion Garden during the 2026 festival.
opportunities.content: A photographer-friendly event concept: get into the tulip garden early for quieter views and better light during Tulip Time.
opportunities.why_interesting: It demonstrates that event data can become a very specific push, not just a generic festival listing.
opportunities.evidence_note: Tulip Time events page exposes 2026 schedule rows, including Photo Walk at Tulip Immersion Garden.

opportunities.title: Watch Holland's Kinderparade during Tulip Time
opportunities.subtitle: A signature parade turns tulip season into a citywide family outing.
opportunities.content: The parade is the user-facing hook: combine tulip viewing, downtown Holland, and a scheduled family-friendly event.
opportunities.why_interesting: It shows how a bloom source can produce event-led recommendations, not only flower-status alerts.
opportunities.evidence_note: Tulip Time events page lists Gentex Kinderparade on May 7, 2026.

opportunities.title: Take BBG's spring highlights tour while the garden is changing fast
opportunities.subtitle: Brooklyn Botanic Garden runs Seasonal Highlights Tours through late May.
opportunities.category: Cherry blossoms and spring garden bloom
opportunities.content: A guided tour helps users turn CherryWatch and spring bloom status into a visit with context from Garden Guides.
opportunities.why_interesting: It adds an activity layer to a garden bloom source: not just what is flowering, but what to do there.
opportunities.evidence_note: BBG calendar lists Seasonal Highlights Tour; CherryWatch page provides bloom collection context and image.
opportunities.price: Free walk led by Garden Guides; admission may apply

opportunities.title: Stop by BloomFest during DC cherry blossom season
opportunities.subtitle: NPS listed a daily BloomFest welcome area at the Tidal Basin during the 2026 festival window.
opportunities.content: A straightforward visitor prompt: go to the Tidal Basin, use the BloomFest welcome area, and pair it with peak bloom timing.
opportunities.why_interesting: It combines official bloom status with an official on-site activity layer from NPS.
opportunities.image_credit: National Park Service cherry blossom event image
opportunities.source_name: NPS Cherry Blossom Events and Bloom Watch
opportunities.evidence_note: NPS Events and Activities page lists BloomFest; NPS Bloom Watch records 2026 peak bloom on March 26.

opportunities.title: Hear a ranger explain the cherry blossoms at Jefferson Memorial
opportunities.subtitle: NPS ranger talks ran twice daily during the 2026 cherry blossom activity window.
opportunities.content: This is the activity version of bloom watching: visitors get a short interpretive program while seeing the blossoms around the Tidal Basin.
opportunities.why_interesting: It proves the product can surface ranger programs, not only festivals.
opportunities.image_credit: National Park Service cherry blossom event image
opportunities.source_name: NPS Cherry Blossom Events and Bloom Watch
opportunities.evidence_note: NPS Events and Activities page lists Jefferson Memorial Cherry Blossom Ranger Talks; Bloom Watch gives the peak window.

opportunities.title: End a DC cherry blossom day with Petalpalooza fireworks
opportunities.subtitle: National Cherry Blossom Festival's Petalpalooza adds music, riverfront activity, and fireworks to bloom season.
opportunities.content: A high-intent event card: afternoon and evening festival programming, capped by fireworks, timed inside peak bloom season.
opportunities.why_interesting: It is the kind of specific, visual, social activity a user might actually save or share.
opportunities.image_credit: National Park Service cherry blossom event image
opportunities.source_name: National Cherry Blossom Festival + NPS event page
opportunities.evidence_note: NPS Events and Activities page lists Petalpalooza with time, location, and fireworks; Festival page provides event context.
